records.quote: If M (x1, y1), N (x2, y2) are two points on the coordinate plane
records.text: If $M(x_1,y_1)$, $N(x_2,y_2)$ are two points on the coordinate plane then: $KM = |OB - OA| = |x_2 - x_1|$; $KN = |NB - KB| = |y_2 - y_1|$; since $\triangle NKM$ is a right angle in K (Pythagorean theorem), $(MN)^2 = (KM)^2 + (KN)^2 = (x_2-x_1)^2 + (y_2-y_1)^2$, therefore $MN = \sqrt{(x_2-x_1)^2 + (y_2-y_1)^2}$.

objectives.label: Find the distance between two points on the same axis
objectives.description: Find the distance between two points that both lie on the x-axis or both on the y-axis by taking the absolute value of the difference of their coordinates.

objectives.label: Find the distance between any two points using the distance rule
objectives.description: Use a right triangle and the Pythagorean theorem to derive and apply the distance rule: the square root of (x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2.

objectives.label: Find the distance of a point from the origin
objectives.description: Find the distance of a point (x1, y1) from the origin as the square root of x1^2 + y1^2.

objectives.label: Use the distance rule to prove properties of shapes and circles
objectives.description: Apply the distance rule to side lengths to decide whether four points form a parallelogram, rectangle, rhombus or square, whether a triangle is right-angled, and whether points lie on a circle, then find areas or circumference.

objectives.label: Decide whether three points are collinear
objectives.description: Show that three points are collinear by finding the three distances and checking that the sum of two equals the third.
